brief: A herb planter of three cells side by side, each with a bin that drains.

requirements.evidence: Three full pieces at q=-1,0,0; 0,0,0; 1,0,0 forming linear row, secured with 2 jointBolts (0#-1,0#0 and 0#0,0#0)

requirements.requirement: Each cell has a bin that drains
requirements.evidence: Each cell contains hex-bin-full-drain: bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain (drained variants provide drainage)

finish.summary: Built 3-cell linear herb planter (1x3 along q) with a drained full-depth bin in each cell, meshClash clear and structure bolted.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
